<RightConsoleMount mobileConsoleLabel="Fixture actions"><p>Actual console actions</p><input aria-label="Fixture console input" value={consoleText} onChange={event=>setConsoleText(event.target.value)}/></RightConsoleMount> : null}<section id="query-fixture"><UnifiedListHeader resetHref="/fixture" autoSubmit={false}><input type="search" name="search" aria-label="Fixture search" /><label>Fixture status<select name="status"><option value="">All</option><option>Active</option></select></label></UnifiedListHeader></section><MobileActivityAndFiles><button id="open-nested" onClick={() => setChild(true)}>Open nested confirmation</button><ModalShell open={child} onClose={() => setChild(false)} titleId="nested-title"><h2 id="nested-title">Nested confirmation</h2><button id="close-nested" onClick={() => setChild(false)}>Cancel nested</button></ModalShell></MobileActivityAndFiles><FilterBarMore resetHref="/fixture"><input aria-label="Extra fixture filter" /></FilterBarMore>{kind === "stock-basket-resize" ?
